description: Implementation of time-related functions in the Abseil library, including current time retrieval using cycle counters and system calls, with platform-specific code and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClockWrapperForGetCurrentTime
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static method to access cycle clock.

classes.name: TimeSampleAtomic
classes.description: Atomic data structure holding kernel time samples.

classes.name: TimeSample
classes.description: Non-atomic version of time sample data.

classes.name: TimeState
classes.description: Aligned structure maintaining time synchronization state, including last sample, counters, and locks.

methods.name: Now
methods.description: Returns current time as a Time object, using nanos or cycle counters depending on configuration.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeNanos
methods.description: Retrieves current time in nanoseconds, using fast cycle counter or system call.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeNanosFromKernel
methods.description: Gets kernel time and cycle count, with synchronization and calibration.

methods.name: ReadTimeSampleAtomic
methods.description: Reads atomic time sample data into a non-atomic structure.

methods.name: UpdateLastSample
methods.description: Updates the last time sample with new kernel data, recalibrating cycle time.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeNanosSlowPath
methods.description: Handles slow path time retrieval with locking and kernel sampling.

methods.name: SleepOnce
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified duration, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: AbslInternalSleepFor
methods.description: Weak symbol function to sleep for a duration, calling SleepOnce repeatedly.
